content.body:
The W15 TCC "tank killer" was a quick way for the French to respond to the threat of the Axis 'fast-armor' form of Blitzkrieg warfare but was unfortunately not put into production until May 24, 1940, when the military situation was already desperate. It mounted the 47 mm SA mle 37 AT gun on the capable six-wheel-drive chassis of the Laffly all terrain truck.
Original designs called for a general up-armoring of the truck itself (leaving the gun open-top) but circumstances required them to be deployed immediately and they were rushed to the front with only a gunshield for the gun. They were successful despite the haste. The 54th Batterie (five vehicles, as well as some ancillary light AT guns) was credited with 28 tanks and 5 armored car kills in just over a week of combat, but they suffered near-total losses. Had they been developed sooner and deployed more widely, it is reasonable to think that French forces would have been far better able to cope with the mobile Panzers slashing across Northern France.
Nevertheless, when this vehicle finally does make the battlefield, it usually does quite well. The key is to simply think of it as an AT gun that is more mobile. You're not going to engage in a move-to-contact battle or a moving engagement - your driver will die in seconds. Like a typical AT gun, you have to scout out a good position, sit and wait for your kill, kill the enemy, and relocate immediately. Unlike a typical AT gun, you can relocate kilometers, not meters, away. The elevated platform for the gun means that finding cover is somewhat of a challenge. The gun is the formidable SA mle 37 and fires across a narrow 90 degree arc centered on the rear of the Laffly. The forward machine gun is a standard French LMG and may only fire on a 90 degree forward arc. Your vulnerabilities, as well as your largest, most obvious target aspect, are laterally biased, so keep this in mind when finding a fighting position. Don't stick around. Kill your target and move out, your mobility is at least 50% of your value, and you will cause more consternation to the enemy when he can't find you.
Control Variations: Very different control set. Driver position exactly like Laffly Prime Mover, except front window is armored and cannot be opened: (numpad . or Del key) to zoom on viewslit. Crew 2 is gun commander and 3 is gunner for 47 mm SA mle AT gun, exactly like the AT gun crew functionality. Crew 4 mans a light machinegun facing forward on the cab roof, controls exactly like the French LMG, except that the range setting is fixed. Like the Prime Mover, the TCC has 8 forward gears: 1-4 are low range gears, and are used for towing heavy ordnance; 5-8 are high range gears for normal driving. When starting without towing, just shift quickly up to 5th gear for a quicker start from rest.
content.brief: TYPE: Tank Hunter ARMAMENT: 47 mm SA mle 37 L53 Gun 7.5 mm FM 24/29 LMG WEIGHT: 4,960 kg SPEED: 48 km/h (road)
content.title: Laffly W15 TCC (Tracteur Chasseur de Chars)
